name: page-header-4
title: Detail Header With Back Link
description: Detail view page header with a back link, status badge, owner avatar and created date metadata, a contributor avatar stack, and share and edit actions.

standards.purpose: Orient the user in one band: where they are, what this page is, and what they can do.
useWhen: A detail or index page needs a title, context, and page-level actions.
doNotUseWhen: The page is a full-screen flow with its own progress chrome.

rules.check: The page header carries the page's only h1.
Page actions are grouped and secondary to the title, with at most one primary.
The current page is marked as current in the breadcrumb and is not a link.
